## Problem

Describe the documentation or repository gap and link the related issue.

## Change

Explain the result and list affected documents or feature IDs.

## Validation

Describe link checks, rendered Markdown/SVG review, or other checks actually performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change fits the current documentation-only scope.
- [ ] Proposed features remain clearly marked as planned.
- [ ] Related terminology, links and contracts were updated.
- [ ] No secrets, real bank alerts, customer data or executable application code were added.
- [ ] I own my contribution or have identified compatible third-party permissions.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, including the contribution grant.

## Visual evidence

For visual changes, include a preview using non-sensitive examples.
